segments.text: proposition 1 THe originall of lights in the Church procéeded hereof, that the temples in old time were darke, and the chriſtians watched there, in the night.

proposition 2 The eleuation and motion of the bread, in the Maſſe, which is doone by the maſſing prieſts, is taken out of Leuiticus, by reaſon of the lifting vp and moouing of thoſe things which were offered vnto God.
